name: vdb_build_diskann
doc: Single builder: PQ training and compression, partition into shards, per-shard build, merge, disk layout, sample.

overlap.doc: shards a point is put in (traced)

cache.doc: the block reader's and the layout writer's block (traced)

stream.doc: the read length of a C++ stream on a file (traced)

chunk.doc: the write length of a C++ stream (traced)

big.doc: one read or write call for a whole array; Linux transfers at most this much per call

shard_index_bytes.doc: [config] a shard's graph: about 132 bytes per point of the shard (measured, degree 64)

index_bytes.doc: [config] the merged graph: about 205 bytes per point (measured, degree 64)

sectors.doc: [config] 4 KiB sectors of the disk index, the header's included

sample_rows.doc: [config] rows of the sample of the base written for the search's warm-up; a tenth here, 100,131 of a million traced

pq_train.doc: [measure] 59 s traced on 256,000 sampled rows, 20 cores

partition_time.doc: [measure] 91 s traced at a million points
